projectRules.activation: Required empty/progress is activation-local. Ancestor/sibling progress is not this activation's progress.
projectRules.descendants: Retain last completed descendant until THAT descendant reentry; opening invalidates completion.
projectRules.comparator: No first-DFS promotion and no longest-final-capture-only comparator.
projectRules.unresolved: No general history comparator or normative outcome inferred from native votes. Other per-case normative outcomes remain unresolved in this freeze. Guarded unsupported is not a pass.
